m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I am afraid your duel is delayed. You must face Nalia Dunestrider in the Hall of the Specter, but she is nowhere to be found.
Can you go to the Student Dormitory and see if she is still there? Warn her that if she does not show, the duel is forfeit.
I'm ruined! My wand... I lost it somewhere, and I can't compete without it! I know we're competitors, but can you help me?
I was with Randolf Spellshine when I lost it. My world of Mirage has few plants, and I wanted to see Tanglewood Way.
Randolf agreed to help me sneak in to see the street, but it was full of strange and scary tree-people. I had to flee!
Maybe Randolf Spellshine knows where my lost wand might be. Could you speak to him and see if he saw where I lost it?
It's on Tanglewood Way? Oh no! I can't go back there!
Really? Nalia has lost her wand? It's a miracle she noticed at all. What kind of Wizard loses their wand?
Sure, she dropped it in Tanglewood Way, when she fled in fear. I suppose I could have said something... but why would I?
If she can't keep track of her wand, and it harms her in the tournament, more power to the rest of us, eh?
Go and tell Nalia her wand is still there in Tanglewood Way, if she's brave enough to go get it on her own.
All of us at Pigswick Academy must maintain decorum in this trying time, and that means continuing with the tournament.
To the Tournament Hall with you, then, where you must meet with Master Glendemming and compete in your next match.
Return here when you have completed your duel, to continue our investigation into the Spiral Cup's disappearance.
You are overdue for your next match. Report to Master Glendemming in the Tournament Hall, and return here when complete.
